name: academic-skill
description: One academic skill for Norwegian and English assignments, writing, source checks, exam practice, Office files and visual work.

interface.longDescription: Work from a brief and a rubric, revise in your own voice, check sources, practise for an exam, or prepare academic presentations and Office files. Use the same skill for pixel art, editable draw.io diagrams and UML. Academic Skill selects guidance in Norwegian or English. File creation depends on the tools available in your session.
defaultPrompt: Turn my assignment and rubric into a plan.
Check my claims against the excerpt I provide.
Quiz me on my notes, one question at a time.
